title: EHAL Telemetry-API (schema_version 2)
description: Normalized plant telemetry. Power in W; ess_soc in %; grid + = import, − = export; ess_power + = discharge, − = charge (OpenEMS-aligned). Field names: docs/ui/ehal-com.md §C.

sens_grid_power_active.description: PCC active power in W. + = import, − = export.

sens_ess_soc.description: Home battery State of Charge in %.

sens_ess_power.description: Optional ESS active power in W. + = discharge, − = charge.

sens_evcs_active_power.description: Optional EVCS charge power in W (≥ 0).

sens_power_consumers.description: Optional house load in W. Prefer mapped Merker; else derive from grid/PV/ESS.

get_evcs_nominal_current.description: Optional EVCS nominal / max charge current in A.

sens_evcs_bat_capacity.description: Optional EV battery capacity in kWh.

get_evcs_ready_by_time.description: Optional EV ready-by deadline (ISO-8601 or house local time string).

get_evcs_limit_soc.description: Optional EV charge limit SoC in %.
